body:
The release hardens claimed DTA files, but the wider reader tail still needs review: a path-string retry invokes read_spss for unrelated formats, ReadstatError can obscure the original failure, and permissive text decoding can turn unreadable binary headers into an empty frame.

Confirmed on integrated source d7626368f: a .bin file containing bytes([114, 2, 1, 0]) + bytes(60) returns an empty (0, 1) DataFrame under both default and latin-1 decoding, with binary header bytes as its column name. A .bin file containing bytes([255, 254, 253, 0]) * 16 raises ReadstatError("Unable to read from file") with no explicit cause under default decoding, but returns an empty (0, 1) frame under latin-1. These synthetic inputs contain no survey data; the four outcomes are archived in reader-residual-repro.json.

Add failing-before tests for unreadable non-DTA binary input under default and latin-1 encodings and for the SPSS path-string retry. Preserve valid text/XPORT/SPSS and exception causes; do not blanket-catch programmer errors or return empty data as recovery. This is not #712's fixed CSV-to-Stata dispatch or #699's working XPORT branch. Closed #189 and its resolution in PR #200 were read: that change narrowed broad catches to parser/I/O exceptions so programmer errors propagate. Preserve that boundary; the present defect concerns format admission and diagnostic chaining. #805's encoding policy remains separate.

Evidence: slurm_logs/release_landing_2026-10-14/runtime-residuals.org and reader-residual-repro.json. The coordinator independently repeated all four synthetic cases before publication; no production reader was changed by this investigation.

[Release investigation and reviewed issue disposition](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/8d7a5e55914e700c69ae1a195f96cc2282b6ce64/slurm_logs/release_landing_2026-10-14/RELEASE_ISSUES.org). This follow-up is separate from the reviewed implementation landings.
title: Keep unreadable non-DTA binaries out of text fallback
